text:
emma: Heads up — reseller CloudHub told us they're launching a week-long Q4 marketplace credit promo starting Nov 15. They estimate ~+180% GPU hours in eu-west for 10 days. Need a quick capacity plan and cost impact assessment. cc @rajiv @ana

rajiv: Can you drop their projected numbers? Need to compare vs our eu-west pool and Dedicated commits.

emma: Here are the numbers they gave (rough):
```csv
period,region,baseline_gpu_hours,projected_gpu_hours
week1-eu-west,eu-west,1200,3400
week2-eu-west,eu-west,1100,3000
total-10d,eu-west,2300,6400
```
They said most workloads are short lived inference (latency-sensitive chat), peak concurrency around 6-8pm CET.

ana: tagging ops — is that feasible without prebooking? also what about marketplace reseller contract limits?

rajiv: Quick notes from infra side:
- Our current Dedicated + hosted spare capacity in eu-west ~3000 GPU-hours/day (steady), but that's spread across instances; sustained burst capacity is limited.
- Autoscaler can add ~500 GPU-hours/day via on-demand cloud spots, but spot availability in eu-west is shaky and yields higher preemption.
- Cross-region spill to us-west is possible but adds ~120-180ms latency for EU customers and ~+25% egress cost.

ops-oncall: Also watch networking quotas — we hit transient ENI limits last month during the reseller promo test. If they drive more endpoints we may need a soft increase from cloud provider (takes 48-72h to approve).

ana: Cost sketch (very rough):
- baseline cost per GPU-hour (eu-west): $3.50 (our blended)
- on-demand / burst: $6.00 / GPU-hour
- cross-region egress: ~$0.12/GB -> for chat workload add ~25% to token-costs
So incremental cost for projected 4100 extra GPU-hours over 10d: ~ (2k @ $6 + 2.1k @ $3.5) ~= $16k-$18k, plus egress. If reseller revenue share/marketplace cut is 30%, net margin tight unless reseller covers burst.

emma: Reseller expects we absorb traffic and they'll pay standard marketplace take; they asked for an estimate we can commit to in 24h.

rajiv: Short-term mitigation ideas:
- Ask reseller to phase promo start (weekday ramp) so we can scale predictably.
- Gate by route: route marketplace traffic to cheaper quantized model variant (q4_8bit) during peaks. Cuts GPU time ~20%.
- Enable KV-prefix caching for chat prefixes to reduce token work.
- Offer reseller optional Dedicated reserve for the promo window (we can prebook N GPUs).

emma: How many GPUs would we need to prebook to keep latency SLOs without cross-region spill?

rajiv: Rough calc: To cover 6400 GPU-hours over 10 days w/out burst = 640 GPU-hours/day. Our baseline 300 GPU-hours/day of spare. So we'd want ~340 extra GPU-hours/day reserved -> ~14 extra A100-ish GPUs (assuming 24h usage). That matches a mid-size Dedicated block.

ops-oncall: Booking that many GPUs for 10d means we need contractual acceptance (procurement) + infra ops lead time to provision images, networking, KMS access. Timeline ~72-96h if we get sign-off now.

partners-bot: CloudHub notification: "Partner promo draft posted — marketplace listing scheduled 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z"

ana: Action items: Emma to confirm with CloudHub if they can stagger promo; Rajiv to run a quick cost vs margin calc for Dedicated reserve (include marketplace fee split); Ops to open cloud quota increase ticket and pre-provision minimal nodes for smoke tests.

emma: I'll push back to CloudHub and ask for a 48h ramp + whether they'll cover burst. Will loop back with a decision by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

rajiv: FYI I'll also prepare a fallback routing policy: if eu-west GPU utilization >85% then route marketplace-v2 traffic to quantized model and mark incident channel.

ops-oncall: I'll open ticket #INC-2026-409 and request ENI/VCN soft limit raise for eu-west, and tag networking/team.

emma: Thanks — sounds good. If anyone spots a blocker ping me in DMs.
